# Velmar Technology

**Managed IT services for the Dominican Republic and beyond.**

We are a managed services provider delivering IT support, infrastructure
management, and help desk operations. This organization develops the tooling we
run on — including our client-facing help desk portal.

## Flagship Project

### [MSP Help Desk — Client Portal](https://github.com/Velmar-Technology/msp_client_portal)

A multi-tenant help desk, billing, and infrastructure management platform built
on the PERN stack (PostgreSQL, Express, React, Node.js) with a Tauri desktop
tray agent:

- Ticket lifecycle, round-robin dispatch, and SLA-based escalation engine
- RMM alerting with automated self-healing and noise control
- Billing with PayPal, wire validation, 18% ITBIS tax, and NCF Series B01
- Subscription entitlements with feature gating and upsell previews
- SOTA authorization: RBAC + Zanzibar ReBAC + policy-as-code ABAC, zero
  standing privileges, workload identity, and step-up MFA
- An MCP server exposing 44+ live diagnostics to AI assistants
